tool.help:
@HELP_AUTHORS@
**Description**
This tool runs CD-HIT on FASTA sequence data to cluster and remove redundant or highly similar sequences. Sequences sharing a sequence identity above the specified threshold are grouped together, and a representative sequence is retained for each cluster.
---
**Input format**
Sequences must be provided in FASTA format::
>seqname1 AAAGAGAGACCACATGTCAGTAGC -on one or several lines- >seqname2 AAGGCCTGACCACATGAGTTAAGC -on one or several lines- etc ...
---
**Parameters**
* **Input files**: a collection of FASTA files (one file per species). * **Sequence identity threshold**: CD-HIT sequence identity threshold used to cluster similar sequences.
Default: 0.9 (90%).
The global sequence identity is calculated as the number of identical amino acids or bases in the alignment divided by the full length of the shorter sequence.
* **Minimum sequence length** (integer): only keep sequences which are longer than the specified value.
Default: 100.
---
**Steps**
The tool:
#. Combines the input FASTA files into a single sequence dataset. #. Runs CD-HIT to cluster sequences according to the specified sequence identity threshold. #. Selects one representative sequence for each cluster to remove redundant sequences. #. Reformats the FASTA headers by adding a specified prefix (defined from the original filename) and ensures that sequences are written on a single line.
**Outputs**
* **CD-HIT Summary**: the CD-HIT log file containing information about the clustering process. * **CD-HIT outputs**: the FASTA file containing the representative sequences obtained after clustering.
